{{Quote|Maybe there were still some old Tech Raiders here when he arrived. They might have helped him learn the lay of the land, taught him smuggler stealth techniques&hellip;and convinced him to become one of them. Maybe his Pop-Dogs are the Tech Raiders of a new generation.|Bhindi Drayson|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''Pop-Dogs''' were a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] unit formed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Stavin Thaal]] after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY|27 ABY]]. Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]], the unit monitored Yuuzhan Vong activity in the system and carried out raids throughout the remainder of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Following the war, Thaal retained command of the Pop-Dogs after his promotion to [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Army]] and used them in his illegal [[Black market/Legends|black market]] operations.

==History==
{{Quote|Thaal's group reported on the Yuuzhan Vong occupation of the system, data vital to the New Republic. They launched raids. They called themselves the Pop-Dogs, after a burrowing rodent from Carida&mdash;pop-dogs pop up out of their burrows, run over, grab their prey or food that’s been left unguarded for just a second, and scurry back to their burrows. The Pop-Dog unit was very brave and very useful, and when that war was over, Thaal was promoted to the rank of general. And he built up elite army units nicknamed the Pop-Dogs.|Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
The Pop-Dogs were a unit of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Army|Army]] founded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] the New Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], Thaal volunteered to lead a unit of troopers based from the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. Calling themselves the Pop-Dogs after a native animal from Thaal's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], Thaal and his men monitored the Yuuzhan Vong movements in the system and launched raids throughout the remainder of the war. Follwoing the Yuuzhan Vong's defeat, Thaal was promoted to [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] and later became [[Chief of Army Operations]]. He retained the Pop-Dogs under his personal command and utilized them in his [[Black market/Legends|black market]] operations.<ref name="MK" />

==Organization==
===Headquarters===
{{Quote|A Tech Raiders base. The black marketeers from long ago. Thaal and his original Pop-Dogs hid out in one of their bases near the city of Vangard to do their guerrilla activities against the Yuuzhan Vong. While I was flitting all over the galaxy with your dad and Piggy and the other Wraiths, Thaal was squatting in a place like this and harming the enemy his own way. But not from this base. This one doesn't appear in his history anywhere. That would explain why he had Fey'lya Base built so far from Vangard and the old clone trooper facilities. He wanted to be conveniently near here—his own black-market staging area.|Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
The Pop-Dogs were based at several former [[Tech Raiders]] bases on the planet Vandor-3, including [[Glitterby Base]], where they stored military equipment and weapons stolen from the Galactic Alliance. Glitterby Base also served as the site of the Pop-Dogs' [[Bacta Triangle Scam]].<ref name="MK" />
